items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer addresses Gil Evans as 'Buster' and asks about a nickname, but Gil Evans does not respond to confirm a personal relationship or identity with a person named Buster.

ctx.x: He told me that she said, Buster don't forget the mandolin. That was his job to remember the mandolin whenever they moved.
And now we've come up with a family nickname too, huh, Buster. What do you call him?
